captions.detailed: An attic gable box fan assembly consisting of a rectangular beige louvered frame and a cylindrical gray drum housing mounted behind it. Inside the drum, a four-blade black fan is visible, supported by a central motor bracket. Two rectangular louver flaps are mounted within the frame on horizontal hinges. A small gray control box with a rotating black speed knob is attached to the lower corner of the frame.
captions.instruction: Create an attic gable box fan with a rectangular beige louvered frame, a cylindrical gray drum housing, a central black fan blade, and two hinged louver flaps. Include a separate wall-mounted gray control box with a rotating black speed knob, defining appropriate continuous and revolute articulations for the fan blade, flaps, and knob.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly using primitive shapes and boolean operations. It builds the main rectangular frame by subtracting an inner box from an outer box, then adds horizontal louvers. The fan drum is created by subtracting concentric cylinders. The fan blade is constructed from a central cylinder and extruded rectangular blades. Two flap panels are modeled as thin boxes. The speed controller is built from a box with a cylindrical knob. Articulations are defined as continuous joints for the fan blade and the control knob, and revolute joints for the two louver flaps.
